name: Apple-1
description: Apple-1 profile using Woz Monitor ROM, optional BASIC ROM and Signetics 2513 character generator ROM asset. Requires a PIA/terminal device for faithful keyboard/display I/O.

ram.description: 8 KB RAM baseline for Apple-1 style configuration

rom.description: Apple-1 Woz Monitor ROM, mapped at $FF00-$FFFF

devices.description: Apple-1 style 6820/6821 PIA terminal interface. Needed for monitor I/O.
Signetics 2513 character generator ROM asset for video rendering; not CPU-addressable RAM/ROM.
GUI terminal panel connected through the Apple-1 PIA terminal device.

notes: Woz Monitor alone can be loaded at $FF00-$FFFF, but visible interaction requires Apple-1 PIA terminal emulation.
BASIC ROM is optional but included because the source file is available.
The Signetics 2513 ROM is a video character generator asset, not a normal CPU ROM region.
